resources.string: As soon as your coach writes, the conversation will show up here.
One thing left: who you are here.
I have a code from my coach
Your coach sends six characters in a message or a link
Set up your workspace: schedule, programs, diaries. Clients join with the code you send them.
Everyone who sets up a coach workplace shows up here.
Next you can build schedules and programs, and clients join with the code you send them.
Detected from your phone. Everyone sees sessions in their own zone.
Link Telegram and the next sign-in takes one tap, with no code from the owner.
Nothing is linked yet — you sign in with a code.
One way in must remain — otherwise you cannot get back into the account.
You will be left signing in with a code from the owner. You can link it back at any time.
Telegram will open — press Start and come back here
Telegram did not answer. Try again or sign in with your email.
The sign-in link expired. Tap Sign in with Telegram again.
I have a code from my coach
It has been a while since we checked it is you. Nothing is lost — your diary and schedule are here.
Six characters from your coach's message
No such code. Check the message — 0 and O are easy to mix up.
The code has expired. Ask your coach for a new one.
This code has already been used. If that wasn't you, message your coach.
Your coach will see the training diary, measurements and photos you send. Other clients see nothing of yours.
You can unlink at any time in your profile.
Ask your coach for a new one — it is valid for 7 days.
This link has already been used
If that wasn't you, message your coach.
Ask your coach for a new one or enter a code.
Your coach will see this name
Enter a name — it is how your coach finds you in the client list.
A name longer than 40 characters will not fit in the list.
Invite a client — they sign in with the code, and the conversation appears here.
Only your coach sees these. Use the same light and angle.
Check the weight: enter a number, for example 82,4
Check the weight: enter between %1$s and %2$s kg
Check the measurements: enter whole centimetres, for example 80
Check the measurements: enter between %1$d and %2$d cm
This client hasn't sent any measurements yet.
Write down what matters: health limits, goals, preferences. The client will not see them.
No habits yet. Add what is worth keeping an eye on.
The client's entries for a period — sets and volume.
No notes yet. Write down what matters: health limits, goals, preferences.
You are booked for this session
Your coach gets a request and confirms the cancellation. The slot becomes free for others.
Cancel or reschedule no later than %1$d h before
There is free time this week — pick another day.
As soon as they open the schedule, slots will appear here. Need it sooner — send a message.
Your coach has no free time yet
Enter the invite code — it is in the message from your coach.
You are not linked to a coach yet
Days off are highlighted for you and your clients, and the weekly slots form preselects the working days.
While it is empty, the app treats Saturday and Sunday as days off — for you and your clients. Turn on your working days.
Turn a day on — the hours will be suggested, you can adjust them.
If you save it like this, the app goes back to Saturday and Sunday as days off.
The end is earlier than the start. If you work late, set «to» to 23:59.
Set the hours or turn the day off
Same hours for every working day
Could not save. The schedule stayed as it was, your changes are kept.
The edited days will go back to the saved schedule.
The coach does not train on this day. Pick another one.
Who took the neighbouring slot is not shown.
Request sent, waiting for the coach
Add slots — your clients will see them right away.
They may have trained without the diary. Ask in the chat or pick another period.
A contact lets you get back in if you change phones. Your coach does not see it.
Write first — the message will go out as soon as you are online.
Invite a client on the People tab — their diary will appear here.
Check the spelling or create your own exercise — it stays in the library.
Add exercises — your clients will be able to pick them in the diary.
Someone already changed this. Refresh the screen.
Ask your coach for a new link or code.
Wait a few minutes and try again.
This section is not open to you.
Check your internet connection and try again.
It looks like the record was deleted.
A new version of the app may be out — please update.
Try again in a couple of minutes.
Sign in again with the code from your coach.
The server did not accept what we sent.
The type cannot be changed after the first entry.
This time is outside your working schedule. You can still create it.
Send an invite — the person appears in the list as soon as they sign in.
Every client can see this session. You can book someone manually.
Check the spelling. The search covers your own clients only.
How many hours before a session a client may ask to cancel or reschedule.
Pushes are sent in the language of the client’s device.
When the diary is a week idle
When there were no measurements for two weeks
In your time zone. Session reminders are not affected.
Without it you cannot get back in on a new device.
Only this device stays signed in. The others will need to sign in again.
Don't recognise a device? End its session.
Lost access to your account? Ask your coach for a new invite link: it brings back your diary and schedule.
Your messages and entries stay on the server. You will need a code from your coach to sign in again.
For exercises outside a program — inside a program each has its own
Nothing filled in yet. Your coach sees the numbers as soon as you save.
None yet. Add what you want to keep an eye on.
Open the calendar — the created slots are already there.
The slots were created. Open the calendar to see them.
Skipped — the time is already taken
Log your first exercise — your coach sees it as soon as you save.
Not sent — it will go out when you are online
Saved on your phone. We will send it when you are online
Check the values in the “%1$s” set
Nobody is logging. Check whether the threshold is too high.
Invite a client on the People tab — requests, sessions and diaries will show up here.
You are not linked to a coach yet
Enter the invitation code your coach gave you.
Your coach has no free time yet
Make your first check-in to see the dynamics
They lose access to your schedule and their bookings are released. Chat and notes stay.
All your clients are already signed up
Build a workout from exercises and assign it to a client — the diary stops being just a log.
No programs yet — build them in your profile.
How closely you followed the plan
Pick a side, then a shot from the strip
Two shots are needed. Attach photos to your check-ins and they will line up here.
Attach a photo to a check-in and it will show up here
The file is %1$d MB and the limit is %2$d MB. Record a shorter video — 20 to 30 seconds is enough.
You can leave this screen — the upload continues. Do not switch the phone off.
Your coach has not replied yet
Your coach watched it — nothing to fix
Film a set and your coach will look at your form and reply.
The video went to your coach
New check-ins from your clients will show up here.
New videos from your clients will show up here.
That email or password does not match. Check them and try again.
There were five failed attempts. You can wait, sign in with Telegram, or set a new password.
No connection to the server. Check the internet — what you typed is kept.
Add a username instead of email
You will be able to sign in with it instead of email
At least 8 characters. Nothing else required
By signing up you accept %1$s and %2$s
That email is already taken. Sign in or set a new password.
That username is taken. Try another one — %1$s, for instance
Latin letters, digits, dot, hyphen or underscore — 3 to 32 characters
Enter your name — your coach will see it.
A password can be restored by email, but letters depend on mail services and sometimes never arrive. Telegram works right away — linking takes one tap.
Open the bot and tap “Confirm”. You will come back here automatically
Now you can sign in with one tap and restore the password if you forget it.
The confirmation never came. Try again — or link it later in your profile, the account already works.
We will send a link to your email — it takes you to a new password.
If we have that address, the letter is already on its way. The link inside works for an hour.
Look into “Spam” — letters from new addresses often land there. Mail services also delay them by a couple of minutes.
The next one can be requested in two minutes — that is how the anti-spam guard works.
The letter could not be sent
The mail service refused it. Try once more or confirm yourself in Telegram — that is faster.
Open the bot and tap “It is me”. The confirmation works for 15 minutes.
The confirmation from Telegram has not arrived yet. Tap “It is me” in the bot and try again.
Nothing left to restore the password with
The letter could not be sent, and Telegram is not linked to the account. There is no automatic way to confirm it is you.
Ask your coach for a new invite code — it brings back the diary and the schedule.
Write to support from the email you signed up with.
Set a new password — you will sign in with it.
Other devices will be signed out — you will have to sign in there again. That is intended: a password is changed when access could have reached someone else.
A password was already set with it. If that was not you — request a new link and change the password.
A link from the letter works for an hour. Request a new one — it comes to the same address.
Not set. Set it to sign in without Telegram
Not confirmed — open the link from the letter
Letter sent — open the link inside
The link has already been used
The link has expired — ask for a new letter in the profile
One way in has to remain — otherwise the account becomes unreachable.
Telegram is your only way in, so it cannot be unlinked. Set a password and unlinking becomes available.
The password is your only way in, so it cannot be removed.
You signed in with a coach code, so we have no email yet. It is needed to sign in with a password.
The current password does not match. If you do not remember it — set a new one with Telegram
Other devices will be signed out.
You do not work on this day. You can still add a slot.
